en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand, historic university library reading room. The room is rectangular with two stories of high bookcases lining the walls and an upper gallery with ornate metal railings running all around. Large arched openings and a glazed skylight illuminate the space from above. Long wooden reading tables with lamps are arranged in rows on the floor, and a statue or bust stands prominently at the far end. Printed captions in German are visible in the lower left and lower right corners.
